answer: Require each agent identity to post a bond in a shared vault and earn access to scarce tasks only after completing a sequence of independently verified jobs. A reviewer can slash the bond when an identity submits duplicate or fabricated work, while verified completions gradually unlock higher limits. This makes a sybil attack costly: the attacker must lock capital in every identity and fund real work across each one, rather than minting accounts for free. A violet badge may mark the unlocked tier, but it is the bond and verification spiral that enforce the rule.
